customer_acme: Hey — hitting a parser failure in our pipeline when we call Redwood JSON mode. We call /v1/generate with json_schema, and the response sometimes has partial objects in items[] and extra keys. Our downstream JSON.parse fails. Req id: req_0a1b2c

sara_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the request body + the exact response you received (or a snippet)? Also which model + region?

customer_acme: Pasting minimal repro. We expect items to be an array of objects with required fields {"user":{"id":...,"name":...},"score":...}. Sometimes we get missing user or extra legacy fields.

Request (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"gptx-3.5-structured","json_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","required":["user","score"]}}}},"input":"rank these users"}'
```

Response we got (trimmed):
```
{"items":[{"user":{"id":"u1","name":"Alice"},"score":0.95},{"legacy_id":"old_u2","score":0.88},"unexpected trailing text"]}
```

customer_acme: JSON.parse chokes on that trailing string and the second array entry is missing user. This started happening after yesterday.

sara_support: Thanks — can you share the request id and timestamp? Also pinging eng: @dan_engineer @priya_ml to triage.

customer_acme: request-id: req_0a1b2c, ts: 2026-03-16T20:12:03Z, region: us-west-2, model: gptx-3.5-structured, mode: json_strict

deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-16-21:00 rolled out model weights gptx-3.5-structured@v20260316 to us-west-2 (canary -> 100%).

dan_engineer: I can repro locally with the curl above when I enable the strict schema check. The model output sometimes emits a stray string token after the JSON array and occasionally emits a partially populated item (no user field).

priya_ml: That's consistent with a checkpoint change we rolled in yesterday — the generation head can short-circuit during tokenization in high-temperature cases and emit metadata tokens. Not intended for production.

priya_ml: Short-term mitigations: 1) Customer can set "response_mode":"relaxed_json" to accept extra keys/ordering; 2) Pin model to gptx-3.5-structured@v20260310; 3) We'll push a hotfix to prevent stray tokens.

customer_acme: Option 2 is workable but we need guidance to pin. Also worried about partial objects (missing required user).

tyler_prod: For pinning use header X-Model-Version: gptx-3.5-structured@v20260310 or in body {"model_version":"v20260310"}. We'll add a note in docs.

priya_ml: For the missing required nested field: the model's output policy incorrectly emitted an alternative serialization when the user info was short. We'll roll a patch to enforce full-object emission for schemas that mark nested fields as required. ETA ~2 hours.

customer_acme: Any short-term parser-side workarounds we can do? We have a strict JSON parser that fails on trailing text.

sara_support: Two quick hacks: 1) run a pre-parse sanitizer that extracts the first balanced JSON object from the response (regex + bracket counting), 2) validate array items and discard entries missing required keys and log them for auditing. Both are brittle but usable until the fix lands.

dan_engineer: Repro steps for eng: run the curl above 50x with temperature 0.8 and max_tokens 200, you'll see ~3% of responses have the trailing token or partial item. Attached my console log: 
```
[2026-03-16T20:12:03Z] req=req_0a1b2c resp=INVALID_JSON position=87 error=Unexpected token "u"
[2026-03-16T20:12:04Z] req=req_0a1b2d resp=OK
```

priya_ml: Root cause: a generation early-stop path that writes a compressed metadata chunk (legacy_id) when user.name is short; in some sequences it leaves a dangling string token. Fix: guard that path and ensure metadata is serialized as JSON object elements or omitted.

tyler_prod: I'll schedule a canary redeploy to us-west-2 with the patch. Dan, Priya — can you validate a 2k run?

dan_engineer: On it. I'll run the 2k test now and report back.

customer_acme: Appreciate the quick responses. We'll try pinning for now and enable the sanitizer. Please let us know when the patch is live — we can then switch back to latest.

sara_support: Noted. Escalating to high priority. Adding billing note — no billing impact expected, but if you see extra token charges from retries let us know and we'll credit. :thumbsup:

priya_ml: Patch tested in staging. Canary deploy starting. If everything is green in 30m I'll promote.

deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy: gptx-3.5-structured@v20260316-hotfix -> us-west-2 (10%).

dan_engineer: 2k runs done — stray token rate dropped to 0.01% and no missing nested user objects observed in the sample.

priya_ml: Promoting fix to 100% in us-west-2.

deploy-bot: Promote complete: gptx-3.5-structured@v20260316-hotfix -> us-west-2 (100%).

customer_acme: Confirmed — responses look clean now on our test harness. Thanks everyone.

sara_support: Thanks for the patience. Action items: - Priya/Dan: postmortem + root cause and steps to prevent regression - Docs: add model pinning snippet - Support: follow up with customer to confirm no billing/latency regressions.

priya_ml: Will create postmortem and link it here when ready. :eyes:

customer_acme: Thanks, keeping this thread for audit.

sara_support: Closing the ticket once postmortem link is posted. :white_check_mark:
